test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All necks are faces.

Some necks are arms.

**Conclusions:**

(I): All arms are necks.

(II): Some faces are arms.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9647e55c37116b091a0d60b0b33365ff82f3aa1d4cbc7277ceec0564684528f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All arms are necks → False (Because, Some necks are arms is given, which implies some arms are necks, but not all arms are necessarily necks).

II. Some faces are arms - True (Because, All necks are faces and some necks are arms, so those part of arms which is necks will also be faces).

So, only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
